verdict.rationale: Loops ships an official MCP server, CLI, and installable 'skills' explicitly designed so a coding/AI agent can manage contacts, events, campaigns, and content via natural-language-driven tool calls (loops-docs-6, loops-docs-10, loops-docs-23–25, loops-probe-4). This directly supports agentic/NL operation of the product rather than requiring manual API use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the MCP server and CLI reliably work end-to-end for natural-language driven tasks (only vendor docs cited).
